lines.text: Give a bit of money to share.
Let's all chip in for her gift.

data.mean: Give a bit of money to share.
data.define: To give some money so a group can buy something.

example.text: Let's all chip in for her gift.

misuse.text: Don't say 'chip in' about potato chips.

data.l1_hook: Mua quà cho cổ? Ai chung không?
data.l1_ex: Mọi người chip in mua quà cho cổ nha.

native.tip: “chip in” = Góp tiền chung. Ví dụ: “Let's all chip in for her gift.”
native.caption:
“chip in” nghĩa là gì?

Ví dụ: “Let's all chip in for her gift.” (Mọi người chip in mua quà cho cổ nha.)
